title: Live Class Status Indicators & Timetable Filter
releaseNotes: Live Class Status: Real-time In-Session and Up-Next countdown badges directly on today's lecture cards.
Quick Schedule Filter: Instant search by classroom, laboratory, subject code, or professor name.
One-Tap Subject Duplicator: Easily replicate recurring subjects across alternate days without retyping.
Performance Optimization: 100% offline-ready timetable query and widget synchronization.
